name: hw-spec-locator
description: Specifications, Redfish and CMDB inventory, PDU power mapping, firmware-catalog ingestion, and AI-fabric switch config for HPE and Dell infrastructure.

offline_mode.title: Air-gapped offline mode
offline_mode.description: When true, the MCP server refuses network calls and reads specs, firmware metadata, and the local mirror only from the offline bundle or the shipped dataset.

tls_verify.title: Verify TLS certificates
tls_verify.description: Verify TLS certificates for Redfish, OneView, OpenManage Enterprise, CMDB, and switch APIs. Leave enabled unless a lab management processor uses a private CA.

redfish_username.title: iLO and iDRAC username
redfish_username.description: Username for HPE iLO and Dell iDRAC Redfish sessions.

redfish_password.title: iLO and iDRAC password
redfish_password.description: Password for HPE iLO and Dell iDRAC Redfish sessions.

oneview_host.title: HPE OneView host
oneview_host.description: OneView appliance base URL, such as https://oneview.example.internal.

oneview_username.title: HPE OneView username
oneview_username.description: Username for the OneView REST session.

oneview_password.title: HPE OneView password
oneview_password.description: Password for the OneView REST session.

oneview_api_version.title: HPE OneView API version
oneview_api_version.description: Optional X-API-Version. When empty, the server reads currentVersion from /rest/version.

ome_host.title: OpenManage Enterprise host
ome_host.description: Dell OpenManage Enterprise base URL, such as https://ome.example.internal.

ome_username.title: OpenManage Enterprise username
ome_username.description: Username for the OpenManage Enterprise API session.

ome_password.title: OpenManage Enterprise password
ome_password.description: Password for the OpenManage Enterprise API session.

snow_instance.title: ServiceNow instance
snow_instance.description: ServiceNow instance URL, such as https://example.service-now.com.

snow_username.title: ServiceNow username
snow_username.description: ServiceNow user for basic authentication. Leave empty when snow_token is set.

snow_password.title: ServiceNow password
snow_password.description: ServiceNow password for basic authentication. Leave empty when snow_token is set.

snow_token.title: ServiceNow token
snow_token.description: ServiceNow bearer token. Used instead of snow_username and snow_password when set.

netbox_url.title: NetBox URL
netbox_url.description: NetBox base URL, such as https://netbox.example.internal.

snmp_community.title: SNMP community
snmp_community.description: SNMPv2c community for a read of PDU sysDescr and sysName. Never passed as a tool argument.

switch_username.title: Switch username
switch_username.description: Username for an AOS-CX REST login when applying pinned commands.

switch_password.title: Switch password
switch_password.description: Password for an AOS-CX REST login when applying pinned commands.

switch_token.title: Switch apply token
switch_token.description: Bearer token for the generic-https switch apply target.

switch_apply_url.title: Switch apply URL
switch_apply_url.description: HTTPS URL that receives pinned commands for the generic-https transport.

bundle_signing_key.title: Offline bundle signing key
bundle_signing_key.description: PEM private key used to sign an offline bundle. Paste the key itself. The server does not read a key file, and the key is not copied into the bundle.

bundle_public_key.title: Offline bundle public key
bundle_public_key.description: PEM public key used to verify an offline bundle signature. A key shipped inside the bundle is not trusted.
